description: Configure a named sensor on `agent`. A sensor runs a script and its output is the reading. `script` is "<script-file> [args...]": a bare filename in the agent's scripts/ folder (no paths - that folder is the only allowed location), with letters/digits-only arguments. On a Raspberry Pi it is a shell script run with `sh`; on a Pico or ESP32 a .py file the agent execs in-process. Pass remove=true to delete the sensor.
name: mcp_sensor_config
